item.title: ‘ Andrei Belousov says to the guards paratroopers, who captured the settlement of Yulyevka:
item.description: Andrei Belousov says to the guards paratroopers, who captured the settlement of Yulyevka: this victory continues the heroic path and glorious traditions of the Airborne Troops Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the command and personnel of the 328th Guards Air Assault Regiment on the liberation of the settlement of Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region). ‘ The paratroopers, displaying courage and valor in difficult battles with the enemy in Orekhov direction, continue to build upon the glorious traditions of the heroes and soldiers of past years ,’ said the Russian Defence Minister. 🤝 Andrei Belousov thanked the servicemen for the successful accomplishment of combat tasks and their fidelity to military duty, and also expressed confidence that the personnel of the unit will continue to serve Russia with honour and reliably ensure its security. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:

Andrei Belousov says to the guards paratroopers, who captured the settlement of Yulyevka:
this victory continues the heroic path and glorious traditions of the Airborne Troops
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the command and personnel of the 328th Guards Air Assault Regiment on the liberation of the settlement of Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
‘
The paratroopers, displaying courage and valor
in difficult battles with the enemy in Orekhov direction,
continue to build upon the glorious traditions of the heroes and soldiers of past years
,’ said the Russian Defence Minister.
🤝
Andrei Belousov thanked the servicemen for the successful accomplishment of combat tasks and their fidelity to military duty,
and also expressed confidence that the personnel of the unit will continue to serve Russia with honour and reliably ensure its security.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏳️ Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’
item.description: 🏳️ Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’ A captured Ukrainian serviceman, Anatoly Kropotov, told about the command's total indifference to the servicemen: ‘We didn't have any training, all we had is a few days of dry fire trainings. They wanted to send us to the frontline ASAP. The only mentioned reason was insufficient manpower there. The brigade commander sends us with some rancour, he doesn't send food supplies, servicemen are starving and killing each other to get some food, to try to survive.’ Leaving the AFU's encircled formations defeated in Dobropolye, the Tsentr Group's servicemen continue to neutralise Ukrainian militants on the line of contact. The only chance to stay alive is to surrender to the Russian servicemen. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30198

🏳️
Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’
A captured Ukrainian serviceman, Anatoly Kropotov, told about the command's total indifference to the servicemen:
‘We didn't have any training, all we had is a few days of dry fire trainings. They wanted to send us to the frontline ASAP. The only mentioned reason was insufficient manpower there. The brigade commander sends us with some rancour, he doesn't send food supplies, servicemen are starving and killing each other to get some food, to try to survive.’
Leaving the AFU's encircled formations defeated in Dobropolye, the Tsentr Group's servicemen continue to neutralise Ukrainian militants on the line of contact.
The only chance to stay alive is to surrender to the Russian servicemen.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade and one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU near Kurgannoye, Izbitskoye, Bugayevka, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and the territorial defence brigade close to Pustogorod, Khoten, and Gnilitsa.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 230 troops, one tank, 15 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Maliyevka, Andreyevka, Blagodatovka, Monachinovka, Nechvolodovka, Tamarganovka, Osinovo, Pleskachovka (Kharkov region) and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 210 troops, three Western-made armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one air assault brigade, one motorised infantry brigade, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near the settlements of Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, and Vasilevskaya Pustosh (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 160 troops, one Italian-made Puma armoured vehicle, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, and 30 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and two national guard brigades have been hit near Krinitsa, Kuritsino, Roganskoye, Belozerskoye, Shilovka, Novoyavlenka, Starovarvarovka (Donetsk People's Republic) and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 335 troops, one U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carrier, six armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
